BETA Close X Serco Group plc has announced the purchase of 1,247,515 ordinary shares on 17 April 2026 as part of its share buyback programme, with an average price paid per share of 298.03 pence. The company's total issued ordinary shares, excluding treasury shares, now stand at 995,837,736, with 6,908,278 ordinary shares held in treasury. The total number of voting rights in the company, excluding treasury shares, is 995,837,736 as of 17 April 2026. Disclaimer* Serco Group PLC 17 April 2026 17 April 2026 Legal Entity Identifier: 549300PT2CIHYN5GWJ21 Serco Group plc Transactions in own shares Serco Group plc (the " Company ") announces that, in accordance with the terms of its share buyback programme (the " Programme ") announced on 5 March 2026, it has purchased the following number of its ordinary shares of 2 pence each (" Ordinary Shares ") through RBC Europe Limited. The total number of Ordinary Shares held in treasury is 6,908,278 . The total number of voting rights in the Company, excluding treasury shares as at 17 April 2026 is 995,837,736 . This figure may be used by shareholders (and others with notification obligations) as the denominator for the calculations by which they will determine if they are required to notify their interest in, or a change to their interest in, Company or its Group under the Financial Conduct Authority's Disclosure Guidance and Transparency Rules.
